requests.title: Requests & chats
requests.subtitle: Your inquiry history and conversations with companies
requests.hint: By default, active requests are shown (pending and in progress). Completed and rejected ones are under «Archive». Incoming — requests to your companies and personal tender bids. Outgoing — what you sent.
requests.emptyDesc: Find a contractor or supplier in the catalog and send them a request.
requests.filterEmptyArchive: Completed and rejected requests appear here. You can open them for chat history or a review.
requests.filterEmptyIncoming: Incoming: catalog requests to your companies, service/material orders, and bids on your tenders.
requests.filterEmptyOutgoing: Outgoing: requests to other companies, showcase orders, and your tender bids.
requests.noMessagesYet: No messages yet — open chat to start the conversation.
requests.dealCompleted: Deal completed — chat is available for viewing and review
requests.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this request? This will also delete the entire chat history.

statusHint.pending: Request created. The company owner has not changed the status yet; they may message you in chat. This is not «site moderation pending».
statusHint.accepted: Both parties agreed to proceed with this request.
statusHint.rejected: The owner marked the request as rejected.

tenders.title: My tenders
tenders.subtitle: Manage status: open accepts bids; in progress / closed — bids unavailable
tenders.emptyDesc: Publish a tender to find a contractor, supplier, or executor — regardless of your profile role.

companies.title: My companies
companies.subtitle: Manage your company profiles
companies.emptyDesc: Create a company profile to receive requests and list services and materials. Available with any profile role.
companies.nudge: You chose «Create company» at registration — add a profile to appear in the catalog and bid on tenders.

reviews.title: My reviews
reviews.subtitle: Reviews you left for companies
reviews.emptyDesc: After working with a company, leave a review on their company page.

settings.title: Profile settings
settings.subtitle: Manage personal data and account
settings.identityCorrection: Name typo correction is available until <deadline>{{date}}</deadline>. Phone cannot be changed after profile is saved.
settings.identityLocked: First name, last name, and phone are locked. Contact support to change them. City and profile photo remain editable.
settings.avatarHint: Shown in your reviews and chats
settings.emailHint: Email is tied to your account and cannot be changed directly.
settings.roleCooldown: Next role change available from {{date}} (no more than once every 14 days).
settings.roleChangeHint: Role change requires explicit confirmation and is rate-limited to prevent accidental switches.

roleDialog.title: Change account type
roleDialog.description: Role is a UI hint, not data deletion. No more than once every 14 days — enforced on the server.
roleDialog.companiesRemain_one: {{count}} company in the catalog and related services/materials.
roleDialog.companiesRemain_other: {{count}} companies in the catalog and related services/materials.
roleDialog.activeTenders: Tenders «In progress» and chats are not deleted.
roleDialog.confirmCheckbox: I understand that changing account type updates labels and hints but does not delete companies, tenders, or chats
roleDialog.confirmPhrase: Type the word in caps: CONFIRM
roleDialog.selectDifferent: Choose a type different from the current one
roleDialog.acceptRisk: Check that you understand the consequences

company.videosDesc: Videos the owner added in company management (YouTube). Full feed — <feedLink>Video showcase</feedLink>.
company.videosEmpty: No public videos yet. Add a YouTube link under «Videos» in company management — they will appear here and in the feed.
company.portfolioOwnerHint: Projects are edited under «Projects» in company management — visible to all visitors here.
company.portfolioEmptyOwner: Portfolio is empty. Add completed projects: title, description, photos — under «Projects» in company management.
company.reviewGuest: Sign in to leave a review.
company.reviewOwn: You cannot review your own company.
company.reviewInProgress: Complete the current request in chat — then you can leave a review.
company.loginToRequest: Sign in to send a request
company.requestDialogDesc: The message below goes to chat with the company first. The request subject appears in the dialog header.
company.requestMessageHint: This text appears immediately for {{company}} in the conversation (separate from the card link).
company.loginRequired: Sign in to send a request
company.requestSent: Request sent — open chat to continue.
company.showcaseEmpty: Materials and services published on the marketplace

verification.hintDraft: Upload documents and submit for review — after approval the company appears in the catalog.
verification.hintPending: Moderator is reviewing documents. Usually takes 1–2 business days.
verification.hintVerified: Company appears in the catalog with a «Verified» badge.
verification.hintRejected: Fix the notes, update documents, and submit again.
verification.hintSuspended: Company hidden from catalog by moderator. Fix data and submit documents again.
verification.hintRevoked: «Verified» badge removed. Company stays in catalog — upload documents and submit again.

offerings.emptySummary: No published items on the marketplace yet
offerings.emptyDesc: The company has not published materials or services on the marketplace yet
offerings.noMaterialsDesc: The company does not sell materials on the marketplace
offerings.noServicesDesc: The company has not published services on the marketplace
offerings.orderSuccess: Request sent — open chat to continue.

chat.title: Request chat
chat.pendingHint: Customer is reviewing the request. Tender author / request initiator can accept or decline.
chat.acceptedHint: Deal in progress. Customer can complete the request and leave a review after work is done.
chat.acceptSuccessTender: Contractor accepted, request moved to in progress.
chat.closedCompleted: Request completed — new messages cannot be sent. Chat history is saved.
chat.fileHint: Up to 20 MB. Signed contract can be attached with the «File» button.

createCompany.title: Add company
createCompany.subtitle: After creation, upload documents for verification — the company appears in the catalog after moderator approval.
createCompany.formDesc: You can specify multiple business categories.
createCompany.name: Company name *
createCompany.descriptionPlaceholder: Tell about your company, experience, and advantages…
createCompany.success: Company created. Upload documents for verification.

completeProfile.title: Complete your profile
completeProfile.subtitle: Name, phone, and city are required so others can reach you for requests and tenders.
completeProfile.intentTitle: What do you plan on the platform?
completeProfile.intentSubtitle: This is a starting hint — you can order and sell later. A company profile is needed for showcase and tender bids.
completeProfile.createCompanyDesc: Catalog, services, materials, tender bids on behalf of your company.
completeProfile.buyOnlyDesc: Tenders, catalog requests, buying services and materials. You can add a company later.

contracts.title: Contract templates
contracts.subtitle: Download Word or PDF — both parties' details are filled from profile and active deals.
contracts.paramsDesc: Your details and counterparty details are filled from profile and active request.
contracts.noActiveDeals: No active requests. Specify counterparty manually after download or start negotiations in chat.
contracts.activeDealsHint: List shows active requests only. Details come from platform profiles.
contracts.fillProfileHint: Create a company or complete profile — details will appear in the document automatically.
contracts.fillManuallyHint: BIN and address not filled in counterparty profile — add manually after download.
contracts.headerCityHint: Order execution city (from tender). Can be changed.
contracts.disclaimer: Texts are for reference only; consult a lawyer before signing.

promoFeed.descBase: YouTube videos — watch, like, and comment right in the feed.
promoFeed.emptyFilteredDesc: Reset filters or pick another city or topic — posts are sorted by time added.

promoFeed.loginPrompt: <link>Sign in</link> to like and comment — data helps personal recommendations.
promoFeed.noComments: No comments yet — be the first.
promoFeed.commentsPublic: Comments are public on the showcase.
promoFeed.commentsContact: For a private conversation with the company, click «Contact».
promoFeed.commentsStaff: For staff contact with the owner, use «Staff inquiry».
promoFeed.commentsUnavailable: Private messaging with this company is unavailable from this account.
promoFeed.quoteCheckbox: Mark as potential order volume estimate request (supplier will see this in the comment)
promoFeed.commentRequired: Enter text or mark volume estimate request
promoFeed.loginToRequest: Sign in to send a request
promoFeed.requestSent: Request sent — open chat to continue.
promoFeed.defaultQuote: Please estimate potential order volume and terms for this offer.
